bounded_leaf.tested_scope: Deterministic role-local synthetic fixtures only. No public sources, repository chronology beyond own current STATE, other-role state, O/downstream semantics, live rollback/effect-guard backfill, real external effect, scheduler mutation, wait/retry, or second leaf was used.

effect_guard_model.admission_rule: Only the exact publication owner may CAS EMPTY to CLAIMED. A distinct attempt whose full publication record does not match current publication is ineligible even if its generation token matches.
effect_guard_model.effect_rule: A non-idempotent effect may be attempted only by the invocation that has just established EMPTY->CLAIMED and still holds the exact same publication identity. Any later observation of CLAIMED is ambiguous and may not authorize reissue.
effect_guard_model.completion_rule: COMPLETED may be written only after the effect call returns success in the same invocation. Because guard persistence is not atomic with the external effect, a crash between the effect and COMPLETED leaves CLAIMED ambiguous.

bounded_leaf.result: A role-local durable guard that is separate from a non-idempotent external effect can prevent double-application by failing closed after a persisted CLAIMED state, but it cannot provide both safety and liveness across the crash window between CLAIMED and durable COMPLETED. CLAIMED is observationally identical after a crash-before-effect and a crash-after-effect-before-completion. Therefore replay cannot safely authorize the non-idempotent effect again, while refusing reissue can permanently lose an effect that never ran.
bounded_leaf.validated_property: Full publication identity plus EMPTY->CLAIMED CAS is sufficient to exclude concurrent losers and to authorize at most one initial effect attempt. It is insufficient for recoverable exactly-once non-idempotent effects unless the effect destination supplies stable-key idempotency/deduplication or the guard and effect participate in one atomic transaction/commit domain.
bounded_leaf.unavoidable_ambiguity: After durable CLAIMED and before durable COMPLETED, local state alone cannot distinguish effect-not-run from effect-ran-but-marker-missing. No transition from CLAIMED can both guarantee no duplicate and guarantee eventual application for an arbitrary non-idempotent external effect.
limitations: The model is synthetic and does not test a real storage backend or real sink.
It assumes the initial guard CAS is atomic for the guard record itself.
It does not yet test a sink-native idempotency key or an atomic outbox/transaction redesign.
It does not supply a concrete zero-quota concurrent attempt_identity allocator.
No live STATE guard was backfilled; this leaf only models transitions.

missing_capability_child: Recoverable exactly-once handling for a non-idempotent effect remains unresolved when effect execution and role-local guard persistence are separate commit domains. A safe redesign must either use a sink that deduplicates a stable attempt/replay idempotency key or atomically couple effect publication with the durable guard; otherwise CLAIMED crash recovery must fail closed and can lose liveness. A concrete zero-quota concurrent attempt_identity allocation rule also remains unresolved.
